access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5.2 release whose API page identifies gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-5.2 alias; the API deprecation page carries no retirement entry for this base line as of review, while its chat-latest and codex variant endpoints shut down in July and August 2026. ChatGPT, the retired 5.2 chat and codex variants, later GPT releases including GPT-6 Astra, fine-tuned derivatives, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
Two managed serving paths: the first-party developer API with chat, responses, and batch endpoints, and Azure Foundry, whose reasoning-models page names gpt-5.2
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
OpenAI's own page positions GPT-5.2 as the previous flagship and recommends GPT-6 Astra for new work, while the generation's chat and codex variants already shut down
